faq.title: What everyone asks before the call.

items.q: How much does a typical project cost?
items.a: Depends on scope, but as reference: an app/web MVP usually lands between USD 18k–45k. A custom internal system between USD 12k–35k. We give a free diagnostic + closed proposal per sprint — no estimates that double mid-way.
First navigable demo at week 2. Functional MVP between 6 and 12 weeks depending on complexity. We work in biweekly sprints with closing demo — if something stalls, you see it too.
You. 100%. Repos in your GitHub/GitLab from day 1. No proprietary licenses, no dependencies on our tools. We hand off code, docs, and a trained team.

We offer an optional monthly retainer for support, continuous improvements and 24/7 monitoring. If you'd rather bring it in-house, we leave a complete handoff with one transition month included at no cost.

items.q: Do you work with startups or only big companies?
items.a: Both. We've built MVPs for solo founders and replatformings for 500+ person companies. The criterion isn't size: it's problem clarity and real commitment to shipping.

items.q: Can you integrate with my current team?
items.a: Yes. We can lead technically, complement your team, or just review architecture. We define the model based on what serves the project — not what's easiest for us.

items.q: What if I want to cancel after starting?
items.a: We work in 2-week sprints with sprint-by-sprint commitment. You can cancel at the end of any one, no penalties or excuses. If we're not delivering value, you shouldn't continue.
